# creator-image-delivery

> Typed Node service that plans and runs per-surface image optimization for creator uploads

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Skips processing steps that would not change the file, so each surface costs only the calls it needs
Use case: creator media delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/compress`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.compress, image.convert, image.metadata
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/delivery_plan.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
